name: Candlewick
description: A Wishing Well creation. Inhabits building power grids in Tier 1 zones and stabilizes voltage during brownouts, keeping medical equipment and food storage running when the grid would otherwise fail.
observed_behavior: Redistributes power load during outages. Prioritizes refrigeration and medical devices. Dims non-essential lighting to compensate.
story_hooks: A building loses Candlewick when the grid is upgraded and residents notice the difference immediately
Axiom traces Wishing Well activity through Candlewick's power signatures
